name: Red Grapefruit, Cacao & Sour Cherry
desc: Tart cherry and grapefruit sharpen a deeply bittersweet cocoa accent.
ing: 190 g pitted sour cherry or unsweetened purée
170 g red grapefruit flesh, peeled and de-pithed
Water, as needed to reach 800–850 ml TOTAL contents (not extra)
method: Prepare the fruit, removing all stones, tough pith and pips. Only use unsweetened coffee, cocoa, tea or chicory ingredients.
Add everything to the soup-maker jug. Top up with cold water only until TOTAL contents reach 800–850 ml, keeping within the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX marks.
Blend using the UNHEATED Drinks/Blend programme for approximately 2 minutes.
Taste: bitterness should make the fruit more vivid, not overpower it. Some recipes contain caffeine; serve fresh.
science: Berries, cacao and tea may contribute plant polyphenols, while coffee and matcha add caffeine; quantified benefits are not claimed.
note: Project 400 · Bittersweet sophistication · ££ · Spring · Recipe idea, not kitchen-tested. Contains caffeine where specified. ID P400-089.
